one_line: AI financing expands, Google pushes AI in schools, new models debut, safety tools target fraud.

themes.title: AI chip financing and acquisitions
themes.text: SpaceX seeks up to $500 M from investors for its $40 B GPU debt, AMD records a $1.1 billion non‑cash charge from AI chip warrants, TeraWulf secures a Google credit backstop for an Anthropic data center, and CrowdStrike plans to buy Fiddler AI and Dreadnode for $495 million.

stories.headline: Goldman Sachs and Apollo seek investors for up to $500 M slices of SpaceX’s $40 B chip financing
AMD records $1.1 billion non‑cash charge from OpenAI, Meta AI chip warrants
TeraWulf secures Google credit backstop for Anthropic Kentucky data center project
CrowdStrike to acquire Fiddler AI and Dreadnode for $495 million

themes.title: Google ties AI to school search
themes.text: Google allows K‑12 administrators to disable Gemini tools, but schools that block AI will lose access to Google Search, which now always includes AI Mode and AI Overviews.

stories.headline: Google lets schools disable Gemini but forces AI in Search
Google will cut search access for schools that reject its AI tools

themes.title: New AI models launched
themes.text: Anthropic released the FlashProve prototype that generates cryptographic proofs for Llama 4 Maverick, IndiaAI Mission unveiled three indigenous foundation models including EKA‑1 and Dhīr 2B/5B, and OpenAI introduced Daybreak Red, a GPT‑5.6 Cyber model available in AWS GovCloud for authorized cybersecurity work.

stories.headline: Anthropic releases FlashProve prototype for provable inference on Llama 4 Maverick
IndiaAI Mission unveils three indigenous AI foundation models
Daybreak Red available on AWS GovCloud for authorized cybersecurity work

themes.title: AI safety tools and fraud alerts
themes.text: Pangram launched Image 1.0 and Image Flash 1.0 models claiming high detection accuracy for AI‑generated media, while India’s I4C warned banks, NBFCs and fintech firms of AI‑driven fraud attacks and urged rapid incident reporting.

stories.headline: Pangram launches Image 1.0 and Image Flash 1.0 AI detection models
India's cyber agency warns banks and fintechs of AI-driven fraud attacks
I4C warns Indian banks and fintechs of AI‑led cyberattacks
